scheduler.resume_rule: Only config-digest-matched scalar/state checkpoints and completed size lanes are accepted. Aggregation fails closed until all 30 units exist.

acceptance_criteria: All 30 deterministic units complete and aggregation accepts only config-digest-matched lane outputs.
Streaming Krylov magnetization agrees with a batched small-system oracle within 2e-12, while norm and energy drift remain below 1e-8 in every frozen candidate-size quench lane.
TDVP periods and integrated leakages satisfy the printed anchors, and the last two independently evaluated finite-ring residual estimates satisfy the declared convergence threshold.
Every candidate Fig. 2(a) symmetry block is Hermitian and yields a finite r statistic; the omitted plotted L sequence remains parameter_ambiguity and is never promoted to paper_exact.

The candidate-size quench lanes cover the paper's visible t*Omega=0..300 range and retain the declared thermal-relaxation and Z2-revival features for spins 1/2, 1, and 2; missing L provenance prevents paper_exact promotion.
No author code, author arrays, digitized curves, source pixels, or PDF pixels enter the numerical runner.

A stable difference is first classified as reproduction_defect, parameter_ambiguity, insufficient_compute, or inconclusive; paper_error_candidate additionally requires paper-exact inputs, convergence, two independent cross-checks, source pinpoint, and a fresh protocol-v2 review.
